semiconductor_relevance: High — SGS Intelligent Equipment specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly in backgrind, slicing, lapping, and polishing processes.
summary: SGS Intelligent Equipment (Jiangsu) Co., Ltd. provides advanced equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on processes such as backgrind, slicing, lapping, and polishing. They also offer inspection and measurement tools for defect detection and film thickness measurement, catering to the needs of semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Backgrind, slicing, lapping, and polishing equipment
